description.fun: A shy little witch-in-training that feels everyone's emotions through the hat-like tail on its head. Strong feelings wear it out, so it runs from them as fast as it can and prefers places where nobody lives. It will only warm to someone with a calm disposition. Its line is all female, a mirror of the all-male Impidimp line beside it in the Pokédex.
description.guide: A small Psychic-type Pokémon that senses the emotions of others through the protrusion on its head, and avoids strong emotions and crowded places. Hatenna's line is female-only and resembles witches. It evolves into Hattrem and then Hatterene.
description.tagline: An emotion-sensing baby witch that flees strong feelings

description.fun: To Hattrem, strong emotions feel like deafening noise, even happy ones. So when someone nearby is feeling too much, it silences them by pummelling them with its braids, and one blow could knock out a professional boxer. Its hair-hat may play on the folk belief that a witch's power lives in her hair.
description.guide: The middle stage of Hatenna's line, a witch-like Psychic Pokémon that experiences strong emotions as loud noises. Hattrem silences anyone giving off strong emotions by striking them with its braids.
description.tagline: Silences loud feelings with a knockout swing of its braids

description.fun: Known as the Forest Witch, Hatterene guards silent woods: if a forest shows no sign of living creatures, you may have wandered into its territory. It sends out psychic power strong enough to give intruders headaches, and anyone too loud risks the claws on its long hair. That floor-length hair may also nod to Rapunzel.
description.guide: The final evolution of Hatenna, a Psychic and Fairy Pokémon known as the Forest Witch. Hatterene lives alone in quiet forests and drives away intruders with headache-inducing psychic power. It has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: The Forest Witch, and she wants silence

description.fun: Called the Raging Goddess, it can sense emotions nearly 50 km away and fires lightning-like beams from its tentacles the moment it senses hostility.
